title: RACORN: Robust Predicate-Agnostic Filtered Vector Search under Extreme Selectivity
abstract: arXiv:2607.00768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Filtered vector search returns the nearest neighbors among the vectors that pass a predicate. The predicate is often selective: most tag queries of the Big ANN filtered track select less than 1% of YFCC 10M. Predicate-agnostic methods search one HNSW graph built without metadata and so take any predicate, but below a few percent selectivity they break down. ACORN-1 draws candidates only from passing neighbors and its recall collapses below 1%. HNSW keeps searching but spends about ef/s expansion cycles at selectivity s. We present RACORN-1, an extension of ACORN-1 that keeps its graph and filter-first traversal and adds Adaptive Search Fallback. When the two-hop expansion of a node falls short of a target, failing nodes enter the candidate queue as bridges, under a per-expansion budget, but never enter the result queue. RACORN-1 serves the selectivities ACORN-1 cannot: from 1% down ACORN-1 no longer reaches recall 0.9 at any ef

translated_title: RACORN：极端选择性下鲁棒的谓词无关过滤向量搜索
translated_abstract: 过滤向量搜索的目标是在满足谓词条件的向量中返回最近邻。谓词往往具有很强的选择性：Big ANN 过滤赛道的多数标签查询仅选择 YFCC 10M 数据集中不到 1% 的数据。谓词无关方法在不依赖元数据构建的单个 HNSW 图上进行搜索，因此可接受任意谓词，但当选择性低于几个百分点时它们便会失效。ACORN-1 仅从满足条件的邻居中提取候选，其召回率在选择性低于 1% 时急剧崩溃。HNSW 虽能继续搜索，但在选择性 s 下大约需要 ef/s 次扩展周期。我们提出 RACORN-1，作为 ACORN-1 的扩展，它保留了原有的图结构和“过滤优先”的遍历方式，并引入了自适应搜索回退机制。当某节点的两跳扩展未达到目标时，失败节点会作为“桥”进入候选队列（受每次扩展预算的限制），但永远不会进入结果队列。RACORN-1 能够覆盖 ACORN-1 无法处理的选择性范围：在 1% 以下的选择性区间，ACORN-1 在任何 ef 设置下都无法达到 0.9 的召回率。
tldr: RACORN-1 通过自适应搜索回退机制将过滤失败的节点作为“桥”引入候选队列，使谓词无关的过滤向量搜索在低于 1% 的极端选择性下仍能保持高召回率。
en_tdlr: RACORN-1 introduces an Adaptive Search Fallback that admits failing nodes as bridges into the candidate queue, enabling predicate-agnostic filtered vector search to maintain high recall at extreme selectivities below 1%.
